hero.firstParagraph: I am a 22-year-old developer, mostly working on websites. Daily I work with PHP, Vue and the WordPress CMS, building themes using Roots/Sage. I also have experience integrating external services such as InPost. Apart from technical work, I collaborate closely with the marketing, sales and SEO departments, and I participate in meetings presenting our results and planning upcoming tasks.
hero.secondParagraph: I have spent my entire career at CODERHINO. I started as a trainee while still in technical school, where I began my internship and gained my first commercial experience building WordPress websites. Over time, I was given increasingly complex tasks, which I completed successfully and independently. Now I have over 3 years of experience, including both on-site and remote work.
hero.thirdParagraph: Privately, I am a fan of F1, the NBA and Ekstraklasa, and I also enjoy reading books.

items.title: Mid Full-Stack Developer
items.description: My responsibilities are now broader — besides development, I've had the chance to supervise a few interns and delegate tasks to them in Jira. I work closely with TEB Edukacja's sales, marketing, and SEO departments, I'm an important voice at status meetings, and I oversee project work.

projects.title: Maintenance and development of teb.pl
projects.description: In the meantime we continue maintenance work on teb.pl, such as updating offer page headings or embedding information for AI bots on the site. I take part in planning, programming, and implementing new solutions such as alerts about possible integration downtime or highlighting offers and promotions on the site.

projects.title: InPost form integration
projects.description: A small convenience added to the form, systematizing the sending of documents needed by the branch when required — all happening as part of the registration flow. After a few clicks the user receives a shipping code for the parcel locker in the city they chose. In this project I was responsible for the look of the elements informing about the InPost shipment, the API integration, and deployment to the site.

projects.title: Additional project work on the registration form
projects.description: Besides having to keep the form in sync with changes made on the site, e.g. in the integration, we also carry out separate projects within it. I was fully responsible for delivering several of them. One is an upsell window updated with a search feature and new offer combinations, so as to suggest additional products best matched to the user.

projects.title: Project work on teb.pl
projects.description: While working on teb.pl we sometimes carry out larger projects. Working closely with the sales or marketing departments, we plan changes and I'm responsible for programming and deploying them. Projects often involve changing the look of entire subpages, changes to the offer integration, or database structure changes. Worth highlighting here is the rebuild of the offers tab and all work related to additional SalesForce options that the site needs to be adapted to.

projects.title: Maintenance and development of the teb.pl registration form
projects.description: Since the form is a complex system, it sometimes needs, for example, verification of responses from the integration bus or checking registration information such as the time a contract was signed. I also carry out development work on this form, e.g. updating contract drafts, displaying field-of-study labels during selection, or new SMS messages to users.

projects.title: Milestone
projects.description: A WordPress theme for a bilingual high school run by TEB Edukacja — I was fully responsible for this site.

projects.title: Zbalansowani
projects.description: A WordPress theme for a psychological counseling center run by TEB Edukacja — I was responsible for translating the design from Figma into code, scripting the site, and building the ACF field and CPT logic needed for the site to function.

items.title: Junior Front-end Developer
items.description: I kept combining work with school until finishing technical school in April 2024; from June 2024 I worked full-time, mainly on TEB Edukacja projects. During this time I grew a lot, especially in communication and teamwork.

projects.title: teb.pl registration form
projects.description: The first very large project I had the chance to work on — a form that lets a user enroll at TEB school and even sign a contract without leaving home. An extensive system connected to the site's offers, deduplication in SalesForce, additionally generating a draft with a payment schedule and allowing fast payment via the AutoPay gateway. On this project I worked on both the frontend, translating the design from Figma and building logic such as storing form values, and on the backend, designing cron events, creating contract drafts from templates, programming a payment schedule generator based on documentation from the sales department, and connecting the form to the integration bus. I have fond memories of this project and I'm glad I still get to work on it.

projects.title: Rollout of an AI bot informing about offers and branches
projects.description: A very timely project. On teb.pl, the Livechat widget was to be replaced by an AI bot provided by ChatLab, based on GPT. I built the API for this bot according to the sales department's guidelines, and helped define the bot's role, the API action descriptions, and the decision scheme by which the bot could return the right offer, taking into account our database schema and the data in the site's ACF fields. Even though we were often puzzled by the Virtual Advisor's logic, we delivered a working sales assistant.

projects.title: Maintenance and development of teb.pl
projects.description: Another TEB Edukacja site I work on is the main teb.pl site for adult schools. To do work on this site I collaborate with the marketing and SEO departments. I make necessary fixes, add elements to the site, verify how offers display, and navigate the WordPress panel using plugins such as ACF. During this time, a major project I carried out together with the SEO and marketing departments was the blog.

projects.title: Maintenance and development of technikum.pl and teb.liceum.pl
projects.description: For about a year I took care of both of these sites, verifying and making content fixes, updating the site's appearance, and adding needed elements to the registration form, e.g. tooltips. The biggest challenge while maintaining these sites was the Home Education and Art High School project — extending a site built for one high school so that navigation, fields of study, and forms would show the right information depending on the branch required a lot of conditional logic in the code :).

projects.title: technikum.pl website
projects.description: The first project for TEB Edukacja I was involved in — I worked on the early stages of the site, translating the design from Figma into code.

projects.title: ogram.to v2
projects.description: The second version of the ogram.to site, this time built as a WordPress theme, working with the ACF and CPT plugins. I was part of a two-person team responsible for the desktop and mobile look of the site and for how the site worked with content created in WordPress.

projects.title: ogram.to
projects.description: The first version of the ogram.to site — this was my first contact with the Laravel framework. I built styled views, wrote JavaScript scripts, learned how migrations and models work, and used the built-in authentication.

items.title: Intern
items.description: An internship I combined with school, during which I took part in my first commercial projects.

projects.title: CODERHINO company website
projects.description: CODERHINO's company website, built in React. My task was to translate the design from Figma, add animations, and connect the frontend with the backend, using WordPress with ACF and CPT plugins as the data source.

projects.title: How To IAB
projects.description: A clean WordPress theme for the IAB association. My task was to translate the design from Figma into code and write the necessary JavaScript. The site is responsive and works with ACF.

projects.title: IAB Forum
projects.description: My first commercial project during the internship. My task was to build the site's code, including responsiveness, based on a Figma design.

items.title: Trainee
items.description: My first work placement in technical school. During this placement we built a browser layout synced with data from the League of Legends game client. On this project I was responsible for the backend in Node.js.

tebWebsiteDevelopment.1: TEB company website homepage built during development

tebWebsiteMaintenance.1: TEB company website homepage after maintenance updates

items.quote: I have been collaborating with Mateusz for a total of 4 months so far. He is a diligent and persevering worker who won't rest until he finds a solution to a problem. Despite his age, he possesses excellent programming skills, particularly in the field of front-end development. He learns quickly, is communicative, and trustworthy.
items.name: Przemysław Wiencko

items.quote: It was an absolute pleasure working with Mateusz at CODERHINO. Beyond being a reliable teammate, he acted as a fantastic mentor, providing invaluable guidance that significantly helped me level up my technical and professional skills. His knowledge and patience in explaining complex concepts made a real difference in my daily work.
items.name: Kacper Pawlik

collaboration.intro: I currently work as a Full Stack Developer and I'm open to new opportunities and interesting projects.

location.title: Location
location.text: Kraków, Poland — available for remote or hybrid work.

availability.title: Availability
availability.text: Currently employed, open to new offers.

workflow.title: How I work
workflow.text: I move comfortably across both frontend and backend — from the database schema to the user interface — collaborating with designers and product teams.

items.name: WordCamp Kraków
items.description: I had the pleasure of attending two days of talks and workshops around WordPress, programming, and cybersecurity.

items.name: Silesian CYBERHackathon
items.description: During this event I was part of a several-person team whose goal was to build a themed application in 8 hours. We created a simple web panel connected to a sensor for monitoring conditions, e.g. underground.

items.name: Codeweek
items.description: I was one of two speakers for the lesson "Monty Python in IT" during CodeWeek at my school. We presented a Python script for pulling data from Wikipedia and built a live chat using the socket library.

At school I got to know basics of PHP, JS and its frameworks and MySQL. I gained some experience with desktop apps in C# and with mobile apps in Java with Android Studio. In the meantime I have tried to extend my knowledge - from widely used MongoDB, Django or React Native to Kivy or Svelte, also I started my internship at CODERHINO. I finished school with 99% on my professional examination.
